name: Alterac Mountains (Classic)
summary: In the Alterac Mountains, ogres, outlaws, and armies fight over the highlands. North of Hillsbrad Foothills, rain darkens the slopes beneath snowbound peaks. Once home to Alterac and Dalaran, the region now lies largely in ruins.

sections.title: A Shattered Highland
sections.body: Rain falls over the Alterac Mountains, where pine forests climb toward snow at the highest reaches. Three human powers once held these heights: the mountain kingdom of Alterac, the magocracy of Dalaran, and the fortified town of Strahnbrad. Betrayal and war brought them low. Crushridge ogres occupy Alterac's ruined capital, and outlaws hold Strahnbrad. Among Dalaran's shattered remains, surviving wizards labor to restore their ruined sanctuary.

sections.title: Bandits, Beasts, and War
sections.body:
Mountain lions and yeti stalk the frostbitten ridges, while desperate factions fight for the uplands. The Syndicate are dispossessed human nobles turned brigands. From old estates and foothill camps, they strike with blades and ambushes. They clash without end with the advancing ogres.

Deep passes into the high crags hold staging camps for the bloody war between the Stormpike Expedition and the Frostwolf Clan. Both fight over the hidden reaches of Alterac Valley.

faq.q: What happened to the kingdom of Alterac?
faq.answer: Alterac fell into disgrace during the Second War, when King Aiden Perenolde betrayed the Grand Alliance and aided the Horde. After the war, the kingdom was dismantled. Without leadership, its cities crumbled. Strahnbrad fell to ruin, and Crushridge ogres overran the capital.

faq.q: Who are the Syndicate bandits in the mountains?
aliases: why are there rogues in alterac
faq.answer: The Syndicate is an outlaw organization made mostly of former Alterac nobles and their retainers. After losing their land, status, and wealth in Alterac's betrayal, they turned to espionage, assassination, and highway robbery. They seek to reclaim lands they believe are rightfully theirs.

faq.q: What is the massive purple dome on the lake shore?
faq.answer: No dome stands over Dalaran today. After the demon lord Archimonde razed the city during the Third War, the surviving Kirin Tor mages raised a violet shield over the ruins. They removed it early in reconstruction and now rebuild their devastated towers in the open.

faq.q: How do you reach Alterac Mountains?
faq.answer: Most travelers enter the Alterac Mountains on foot from Hillsbrad Foothills, taking northern roads from Tarren Mill or from north of Southshore. Daring swimmers can also cross southeast over Lordamere Lake from the shores of Silverpine Forest or the outskirts of the Undercity.

angles.text: Ravenholdt Manor lies in a secluded mountain valley on Alterac's border. It is the historic headquarters of the thieves' and assassins' guild, led by Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
The Alliance keeps a forward outpost in these frozen hills under Lieutenant Haggerdin. There, it recruits stalwart fighters to reinforce the dwarven Stormpike Guard in Alterac Valley.
